name: Disneyland Harbour Galley Chilled Lobster Roll on Buttered Brioche (Light Mayo Mod)
whyItWorks: Chilled poached claw and knuckle lobster meat served in a split-top toasted buttered brioche roll is lean and low-fiber, though the dressing contains a touch of lemon juice and diced celery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick out any visible diced celery bits and note that the lobster salad dressing includes a hint of lemon (citrusFree: false).
watchOuts: Contains trace lemon in the mayo dressing (citrusFree: false) and butter on the brioche roll
